senses.gloss:
धीर धीर, i. e.
 I. धृ + अ, adj.
 1. Lasting, Cāṭ. 7.
 2. Firm, resolute, Hariv. 3755; Bhartṛ. 2, 72; Hit. i. d. 167; courageous, Kathās. 18, 297.
 3. Solemn, grave, Bhartṛ. 2, 26.
 4. Deep (as a sound), Ragh. 16, 13.
 II. धी + र, adj. Sensible, wise, MBh. 5, 1076; Rām. 3, 19 13; Chr. 290, 1 = Rigv. i. 64, 1.

धीरता धीर + ता, f. (and धीरत्व धीर + त्व, n.),
 1. Firmness, Ragh. 8, 43.
 2. Courage, Pañc. 129, 22.
 --Comp.
